response.sql: WITH record_counts AS (SELECT c.constructorId, c.nationality, COUNT(cs.constructorStandingsId) AS record_count FROM constructors AS c LEFT JOIN constructorStandings AS cs ON cs.constructorId = c.constructorId GROUP BY c.constructorId, c.nationality) SELECT constructorId, nationality, record_count, record_count - (SELECT AVG(record_count) FROM record_counts) AS difference_from_average FROM record_counts ORDER BY difference_from_average DESC, constructorId LIMIT 10;
